_adapted: Adapted from affaan-m/ECC (MIT), commit d3b8a3e. Merged for Neva.

_comments.what: An opt-in catalog, not a config. Neva ships one default server, chrome-devtools, in plugins/neva-core/.mcp.json. Every other enabled server loads its tool schemas into every session, so add them per project only.
_comments.budget: Keep under 10 servers and about 80 tools enabled per project. See docs/harness/06-mcp-budget.md.
_comments.use: Copy only the entries a project needs into that project's .mcp.json, or add them with claude mcp add. Replace every YOUR_..._HERE placeholder. Never commit a real token.
_comments.cost: The cost field says whether the server is free, needs an account with a free tier, or needs a paid API. It is documentation only; remove it when copying if your client rejects unknown keys.
_comments.versions: Entries that use @latest pull the newest release on every start. Pin a version for reproducible setups.

chrome-devtools.description: Browser inspection for visual verification: screenshots, console, network. The one server worth enabling everywhere you build UI.

playwright.description: Browser automation and E2E testing via Playwright. The Playwright CLI in a skill is lighter; use the server only for interactive runs.

context7.description: Live library documentation lookup (resolve-library-id, query-docs). A docs-lookup skill over the public REST API does the same with no resident tools; prefer it.

github.description: GitHub PRs, issues, repos. The gh CLI covers most of this with no tool budget; prefer it.

supabase.description: Supabase database operations. Set your project ref.

parallel-search.description: Web search and fetch returning citation-backed excerpts.

exa-web-search.description: Web search and research via Exa. Use after repo, GitHub and docs searches come up short.
